author: Sufficient_Piece3479
body: Depends on what class/spec you are using but generally Ferocious Bull Eyes and Solarite Mortars for additional 2h power. You want to play around with your crit from broken Bristles and Fero Eyes until you get 96% crit. Then, add/subtract a few Fero as you add in Solarite Mortars to maintain the 96% Crit.

author: Widogeist
body:
It kinda sucks you have the summoner version and not the caster version, albeit you could still use it on Deity for the AoE.

In general, you'd probably want 1x Ashen ruby + ferocious bull eyes (and solarite mortar if you want additional 2h power). The item ability is a very strong AoE *and* it can crit, so you'll want to do a 100% crit build if you're using the staff for horde clearing. 

The skill itself has an innate 5% crit chance, so you'll need an additional 75% crit from other gear sources/adornments - assuming you run Wyrm's Song buff which gives a flat 20% crit.

In my own Yelmogus Greatstaff I run 1x ashen ruby, 11 FBEs and 3 solarite mortars and it works awesome.
